lockFileMaintenance.description: Only mechanism that updates transitive dependencies absent from every package.json. Daily rather than the inherited schedule:weekly (Mon 00:00-03:59 UTC) to cut worst-case exposure from seven days to one; costs no extra PR noise since lockFileMaintenance maintains a single branch. Note: the narrow window is not why this job stopped running after 2026-06-08 — oppijanumerorekisteri runs the identical inherited schedule and has not missed a run. See the commit body.

packageRules.description: Prioritise lock file maintenance so it does not lose the last concurrency slot to routine bumps
Disable digest updates (dev/test infra images, limited value)
Re-enable major updates for GitHub Actions to track upstream Node.js version migrations
Group all Parcel updates together (skip for now)
fs2 minor updates need Hotswap->NonEmptyHotswap refactoring
Wait 3 days before updating Maven dependencies
Pin postgres Docker image to match RDS version (RDS upgrades to 15.17 on 2026-06-03; auto-minor-version-upgrade is enabled in RDS). Bump this constraint when RDS is upgraded further.

Skip Node 24.16.x in smoketests — extract-zip silently truncates Chrome extraction, breaking `puppeteer browsers install chrome` (nodejs/node#63487). Remove this rule once a fixed Node release is verified.
